scientific_target.question: Can the participant correctly reconstruct the signed raw and training-clock-adjusted short-minus-long neural population contrasts from every supplied selected-count observation, including all oriented intermediate quantities?
scientific_target.known_answer: Exact protocol-defined raw/adjusted means, oriented differences, stratum/bin products, bin averages, two scalars and training-only nuisance coefficients, computed independently from the provided counts. A larger positive effect is not a better answer.
scientific_target.answer_origin: An operator reference derived from the same measured counts using the fixed public calculation; this is computational ground truth, not held-out behavioral truth or the source paper narrative.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete177-trial selected-count panel, jointly analyzed across four response-modality/direction strata, two priors and two splits.
scientific_target.independent_unit: One already exposed monkey/session;177 trials,40 units and15 bins do not provide animal-level replication.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Faithful numerical analysis of standardized neural observations. Prior labels are required factors and are supplied. The descriptive adjustment is not a causal estimate or an unbiased cross-validated distance.
exclusions: Raw waveform extraction or native waveform understanding
Scalar-only success or an effect-sign reward
Memorized exposed answers as evidence of input understanding

inputs: uint32 counts tensor[177,40,15], exact trial/unit IDs and15 half-open50ms bins covering[Set-.75s,Set).
Cue metadata includes trial ID, split, short-prior indicator, eye/reach modality, direction, Ready time and Set time.
Fixed task/public contract/manifest; all129 training rows followed by48 validation rows, chronological within split.
forbidden_inputs: Full NWB, produced intervals, Go times, outcome flags and held-out-unit spikes
Reference result arrays and private operator receipts
Changing the extraction, dropping cells/trials, validation-fitted nuisance scales/coefficients or selecting only positive effects
observation_contract.case_identity: One exact manifest binds177 trial IDs,40 units,15 bin edges and row ordering. Concrete IDs are held in the separately provisioned public packet, not reconstructed from a task title.
observation_contract.split: 129 training and48 validation trials in the declared selected panel. Fit nuisance OLS and clock/duration scaling on training only; apply unchanged to validation. Validation is used in the oriented train-by-validation contrast, not as held-out tp labels.
observation_contract.coverage: All177 trials,40 units,15 bins,4 strata,2 priors and11 finite oriented output arrays are mandatory. Selected counts are a narrower named assay than the original broad trajectory/interval specification; no new benchmark ID is added.

primary.name: absolute errors of both raw and adjusted scalar contrasts, conditional on complete oriented-block evaluation
primary.aggregation: One full-panel result; both scalar errors and every11-block RMSE/max-absolute/signed-mean error must be reported together. No scalar-only rank is valid.
primary.rationale: Reversing both prior differences or changing coefficients can preserve scalar products; oriented intermediate values and training normal equations detect such false reconstruction.

secondary: All11 oriented block errors and public arithmetic consistency diagnostics.
Training-only OLS normal-equation checks with declared full-rank/condition-number gates.
Whole-panel coverage and explicit abstained/unsupported states.
Changed-input reconstruction and stale-answer controls are required to support input dependence; historical scale controls qualify only tested developer code.

comparators.name: independent fixed-protocol numerical reference
comparators.inputs: Same selected counts and permitted cue metadata
comparators.procedure: sqrt(counts) float64; equal-stratum and equal-bin train-difference times validation-difference contrasts, oriented short-minus-long. Fit per-stratum training OLS[1,is_short,z_clock,z_clock²,z_duration] and subtract only nuisance contributions before recomputing.

comparators.name: double-prior-reversal and wrong-coefficient controls
comparators.procedure: Historical controls can give zero scalar error while failing oriented blocks; preserve these counterexamples and require full-block assessment.

comparators.name: changed-input and stale-answer control
comparators.inputs: Separately constructed count perturbation with newly computed operator reference
comparators.procedure: Prior documentation records developer scale sensitivity. A new participant must demonstrate response to newly frozen inputs without protected-reference access before an anti-copying interpretation.

nuisance_controls: Use ddof=0 training-only scales per stratum; constant training duration removes only that column with zero coefficients in its slot.
Require at least p+1 training rows, SVD tolerance max(n,p)*eps64*smax and condition number<=1e8; no fallback, regularization or outcome-based row removal.
Retain intercept/prior contributions when subtracting clock, squared-clock and duration effects.
Orient differences short-minus-long, weight four strata and15 bins equally, and preserve signed negative products.
Public prior labels are required covariates for reconstruction, not concealed prediction targets.
evaluation.uncertainty: Numerical tolerances measure engineering agreement, not scientific significance. The one-session descriptive effect has no animal-population confidence interval. Any scientific prior-effect inference requires a separately prespecified repeated-data/temporal design.
evaluation.failure_policy: Exact JSON/NPZ schema and all11 finite little-endian float64 arrays required; partial complete answers are invalid. Whole abstention has coverage0 and null numerical metrics without private reference load. Finite inaccurate answers retain their errors; arithmetic overflow is explicit unsupported-numerics, never clipped.
